title: Nur International University Lahore Amendment Act 2021

sections.shortTitle: Nur International University Lahore Amendment Act 2021
sections.description:
Short Title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 134
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 134
ACT XIII OF 2021
NUR INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY LAHORE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the NUR International University
Lahore Act, 2015
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
17th May, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(61)/2021/2536, dated 17.5.2021.---The NUR International
University Lahore (Amendment) Bill 2021, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab on May 06, 2021, and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on May 11, 2021, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
. Whereas
it is necessary to amend the NUR International University Lahore Act 2015 (VII
of 2015) for the addition of the faculty of allied health sciences in the
University and for other purposes;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
Title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the NUR International University Lahore (Amendment) Act,
2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
